newsitem.title: USA: Jan Bell July same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Jan Bell July same-store sales fall.

text.p: Jan Bell Marketing Inc said on Wednesday its same-store sales for the four weeks ended August 2, 1997, fell 12.17 percent from the year ago period.
Sales dropped 10.22 percent to $12.2 million from the $13.6 million in the similar period of the prior year, Jan Bell said in a statement.
For the twenty-six week period ended August 2, 1997, sales decreased 2.66 percent to $93.3 million, while comparable-store sales fell 4.02 percent from the year ago period.
As of August 2, 1997, Jan Bell operated 445 leased jewelry department operations in all domestic and Puerto Rican Sam's Clubs.
